issue_context.title: ServerResponse.write throws an exception when passing a Uint8array.
issue_context.body:
Tested on node v14.0.0 using an http1 server calling ServerResponse.write with a UInt8array  instance received the following exception. According to the buffer docs, I would expect the api to accept UInt8array as well.

"TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The first argument must be of type string or an instance of Buffer. Received an instance of Uint8Array
    at write_ (_http_outgoing.js:679:11)
    at ServerResponse.write (_http_outgoing.js:644:15)
comments: @addaleax ah thanks, sorry for the dupe. poked around the bugs but didn't check pull requests.

review_comments: Is changing this message potentially breaking? ping @ronag @nodejs/lts
It has an error code, so our policy doesn’t consider it a breaking change, and it’s a typechecking error, so my common sense also says that this should never be an issue.

Okay, thanks 👍.  FWIW, this was a query during our release shadowing/onboarding session today. I'll add a link to the [Deprecation Policy](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/master/doc/guides/collaborator-guide.md#breaking-changes) to the Release guide.
